THE ROOT CAUSE of H26. Fix: strip GIT_* from the pytest subprocess env

Payment-behaviour generator (sim-source, coupled-triad W of the D5 decomposition): baseline generator of customer payment behaviour -- who pays when, DD success/failure, arrears/late-payment patterns, payment-method mix -- ANCHORED TO EXTERNAL real-world payment statistics (Bacs DD failure rates, DD take-up, payment-timing distributions), decided BLIND to company P&L (R13 baseline). Difficulty dials are CURRICULUM (director-authored), not agent-tunable.

Payment observable seam (coupled-triad SEAM of the D5 decomposition): the typed, versioned SIM/company interface through which the company OBSERVES payments -- bank statements, remittance advices, settlement/BACS reports, DD success/failure notifications -- exposing OBSERVABLES ONLY (never the sim payment-behaviour internals). The go-live payment adapter seam (swap sim for real bank/Bacs behind the unchanged contract).

Payment belief-vs-truth gap (coupled-triad HARNESS of the D5 decomposition): the harness measures the company's payment BELIEF (its allocation/ageing/cash-position inference from observed payments, D5) vs the world's payment TRUTH (the W2_11 generator's actual behaviour). No world payment-source reaches L3 until this gap is measured against the company's consumption (COUPLED_TRIAD binding rule).

Is the payment AGEING gap real or a metric artefact? The live coupled-triad measurement reports an ageing gap of 1.1538 -- ABOVE 1.0, meaning the company's debt-ageing belief scores worse than the flag-nobody baseline the metric norms against. Decide which of two things that is: a genuine company failure mode (oldest-first Clayton's-Case allocation actively misdating debt, which a real supplier would recognise) or a metric-shape defect (detection-style normalisation misapplied to a bucket-distance dimension). Until resolved, the ageing dimension is not evidence of anything and must not be cited as fidelity.

Reshape the coupled-triad AGEING dimension: retire the single prevalence-normalised scalar and report the two error directions on their OWN denominators (understated_arrears_rate = misses/n_truly_overdue; overstated_arrears_rate = false_ageings/n_truly_current, the wrongful-dunning exposure) plus an ABSOLUTE mean_bucket_displacement. TRAP, mutation-caught during D6 DISCOVER: any normaliser whose denominator counts the truth's class balance re-imports the prevalence defect whatever the numerator's shape -- ordinal displacement over a no-skill baseline reproduces the same twentyfold swing exactly. The ordinal severity carries no denominator at all.

Report the Clayton's-Case date displacement as a company failure finding in its own right: unreferenced non-DD credits cross the W4_4 seam with correlation_id stripped to None, forcing AccountLedger.allocate's oldest-first fallback, so the company's balance is exactly right while its ageing report is materially misdated -- the real-world driver of wrongful dunning, wrong statutory-interest accrual and misstated bad-debt provisioning. Blocked on D7_ageing_gap_metric_reshape giving the dimension a shape that can carry the finding.

Reshape the coupled-triad DETECTION dimension, which has two defects the 2026-08-09 H27 Expert Hour measured. (a) as_of ARTEFACT: `truth_set` is `result == 'failed'` and never moves, but `flagged_set` is a belief held AT `as_of`, so holding company AND world fixed and moving only the scorer's question date walks the published figure 0.0725 -> 0.1232 (+70% over 60 days, seed 7) -- a case detected on time and later UN-flagged by an oldest-first allocation leaves the set purely because the clock moved. (b) RECALL ONLY: the gap is 1 - |S&D|/|S|, so flagged_set enters only via the intersection and flagging EVERY invoice scores a perfect 0.0, while the published baseline names only 'flag nobody -> 1'. Measured: 44-51% of all flags are on invoices that truly SUCCEEDED.

Three published detection dimensions are still RECALL ONLY after D11 fixed the fourth: the regime-partitioned payment CELL grid (score_detection_by_partition / detection_cell_measurements, which feeds the G1/G2/G3 fidelity band), and the W2_5<->C7 and W2_8<->C10 self-rationing pairs. On each, a company that flagged EVERY case scores a perfect 0.0. They are registered as named debt in tools.couple_w2_11_d5.DETECTION_DIRECTION_CONTRACT, whose control fails if any of them is ever declared two-directional without becoming so.

The W2_5<->C7 and W2_8<->C10 self-rationing detection dimensions are still RECALL ONLY -- a company that flagged EVERY household scores each a perfect 0.0. They cannot be fixed the way D12 fixed the payment cell grid, because `detection_measures` needs the cases a flag would be WRONG on and 'a household that is not self-rationing' is a continuum the harness labels by THRESHOLD, so that denominator is a modelling choice rather than a set already in hand. DISCOVER whether a settled-fact negative population exists for self-rationing at all -- and accept 'no second direction is publishable here' as a legitimate finding.

W2_8's world contains NO hard negatives: 0 of 3752 non-rationers have any consumption drop at all (the not-onset branch returns observed == healthy exactly) and 0 are flaggable under any weather factor, so the false-flag rate is 0.0000 for ANY drop-based detector -- a property of the WORLD published as if it were detector precision. The W2_8<->C10 second direction cannot honestly publish until the world emits non-rationers who DO drop: a house move, an efficiency retrofit, a vacancy, a mild-winter behavioural cut. WORLD-first, not a metric fix. Also fix here, not before: couple_w2_8_c10.py's false_positive_rate divides by n_customers - len(truth_set), sweeping the 56 truly-rationing-but-above-floor households (the NEITHER set) into the negatives -- the D11 denominator defect, in shipped code, currently costing 0.

W2_5<->C7 CAN publish a false-flag rate -- its negative is settled (income_stress LOW at both year ends, a discrete state, not a threshold) -- but the exclusion boundary swings the measured rate x2.88 with company behaviour literally fixed: naive 0.1661 / exclude-carried-HIGH 0.1491 / LOW-both-ends 0.0576. The swing is driven by income_stress PERSISTENCE: 2772 instances (14.7% of the naive denominator) are years with no distress EVENT but carried-in distress, where a C7 flag is CORRECT. Publish the second direction on the settled negative, and put the three-way exclusion to the director as an R13 curriculum call with all three rates on the table -- never chosen by the agent that benefits from the atom closing.

The W2_11<->D5 triad publishes 'the wrongful-dunning exposure' TWICE, from two dimensions, as two numbers 3.5x apart: detection's false_flag_rate 0.0269 (21 of 782) and ageing's overstated_arrears_rate 0.0951 (101 of 1062), sharing SEVEN cases. D11 established that an invoice paid past its grace date genuinely WAS unpaid past grace, so a flag on it was CORRECT, and excluded those cases from the detection denominators -- and that rule was applied to the detection dimension ONLY. Ageing carries no exclusion band at all, so 94 of its 101 false ageings land on cases the sibling dimension of the same instrument holds the company was RIGHT about. Carry D11's exclusion across to the ageing dimension, or declare in the published note which of the two a reader should take as the company's exposure.

W2_8's new drop confounders (D14) are ANSWER KEY: the company cannot see that a household MOVED OUT, that a property stood empty, or that its own ECO scheme insulated the home -- so it false-flags 0.0560 of the settled negative with no way to explain any of it away. A real supplier holds several of those records itself: a change-of-tenancy registration on the account, a void notification, its own install file. Detection here is therefore strictly HARDER than reality and the published false-flag rate is an UPPER bound. Give the C10 detector an OBSERVABLE confounder channel -- with realistic DISCOVERY LATENCY, since the CoT scope brief's point is that nobody is told for weeks or months -- and measure the gap between what a supplier could explain away and what it actually does.

The maturity map's own spine ratchet is RED ON COMMITTED HEAD and has been for some time: tests/design/test_simplifications_store.py::test_map_within_size_ratchet_when_store_populated asserts maturity_map.yaml < 409600 bytes and HEAD is 464110 (measured 2026-08-09, before that tick's edits). Every atom that records its work honestly makes it worse, so the ratchet currently penalises the behaviour the map exists for. Decide which it is: the ceiling is wrong for a map this size (raise it with a stated reason), or the long-note fields belong in the store beside `simplifications` (rehome them, as the H27 register was rehomed rather than trimmed). It may NOT be closed by trimming build notes -- that is paying a size warning with the record.

The D8 remittance counterfactual now attributes 100% of EVERY measure it publishes, so its own anti-rubber-stamp guard guards nothing. That guard rested on one residual -- the ageing overstatement the counterfactual could not explain (0.2188 of 0.2803 on the live fixture) -- and D16 measured that residual to be composed entirely of cases where cash arrived PAST the reconciliation grace, i.e. invoices the company was RIGHT to carry as owed. With those excluded, every published measure reads attributed == actual. Either MEASURE a partial attribution by injecting a belief error no invoice reference can cure, or establish and state that this world structurally cannot produce one -- because on it, ageing an invoice settled within five days of its due date REQUIRES a misallocation.

The published DETECTION headline of the W2_11<->D5 triad is insensitive to the entire DD-observation channel: `flagged_set` is a UNION and n_flagged_via_dd_channel_only == 0 across seeds 7/11/23, so deleting the DD channel outright leaves the number bit-identical. Set-membership detection is structurally blind to the only thing that channel buys -- EARLIER detection. Give the dimension a shape that can see latency (the latency distribution is already measured and discarded into a summary), or state in the published note that the headline is reconciliation-determined alone.

The Proof-door coupled-gap panel renders ANY gap>1 as the red chip 'worse_than_blind' (tools/generate_proof_data.py::_coupled_gaps, mirrored in background/sanity_daemon.py and the site panel). For detection_gap that reading is valid; for misapplication_gap the D6 DISCOVER refuted it -- >1 there means the minority-class share is small, not that the company is worse than blind. The renderer must read the METRIC, not just the number, before printing a red verdict on a public surface.

Size the OPENING level direct debit from an annual estimate, not from one seasonal month's bill

Per-customer level-DD seasonal cash-flow physics: summer-credit / winter-drawdown balances, held customer credit booked as a LIABILITY, annual DD review as a first-class event, and the cash-rich-but-insolvent tell made visible (DD1-DD5 + DD-H)

Site evidence pages behind the diagram nodes: each model-on-a-page node links to a page showing the primary-state evidence (numbers, tests, provenance) that substantiates its claimed stage -- the harness's content, made inspectable
